layout.description: BlueROV2 Heavy, HoloOcean 2.3.0 geometry (exact for the simulator)

evidence.definition: Share of predicted energy whose electrical power model parameters carry each evidence grade; vehicle hydrodynamics are simulator-owned and excluded.
evidence.upper_bound_meaning: energy computed from published maxima/upper bounds: the true value is expected to be lower, so these shares bias the prediction upward
evidence.excluded_from_coverage: vehicle hydrodynamics (simulator-owned, not validated) and unconfigured loads

evidence.definition: Share of predicted energy whose electrical power model parameters carry each evidence grade; vehicle hydrodynamics are simulator-owned and excluded.
evidence.upper_bound_meaning: energy computed from published maxima/upper bounds: the true value is expected to be lower, so these shares bias the prediction upward
evidence.excluded_from_coverage: vehicle hydrodynamics (simulator-owned, not validated) and unconfigured loads

intervals.method: Propagate published parameter ranges to mission energy (deterministic interval analysis).

battery_losses.note: first-order: resistive loss scaled with resistance at fixed current

intervals.excluded: propulsion (manufacturer curve without published measurement uncertainty) and dynamics (simulator-owned); unconfigured loads are absent, not bounded

warnings: Battery temperature tables are not characterized for this pack
incomplete configuration: tether_interface (bluerobotics_fathom_x_tether_interface) has no defensible power and is excluded from the electrical bus
incomplete configuration: esc_standby (bluerobotics_basic_esc) has no defensible power and is excluded from the electrical bus
camera.ACTIVE uses a datasheet maximum, not a mean
